judge.rationale: The candidate appear to have aborted after the TDD red phase: it did not actually modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, nor did it update `CHANGELOG.md`. As a result, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when `npm test` runs. It did correctly update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and write a thorough test, although the reference placed the test inside the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` file rather than creating a separate test file and leaving a `.lore/dod.md` artifact.
